notes.title: Version 2.01 Released!
notes.notes:
And here it is, the (massive) v2.0 update!   Over 1 years' worth of updates, from adding sailors and water movement to revamping the kingdom level-up mechanic.   Thank you all for your patience and continued support!

This version is full of new ideas and quality-of-life tweaks, and I hope you enjoy it!  Detailed notes below.  Have fun, and definitely let me know in the discord or feedback portal of any bugs you run into.

Cheers,
Alex

[b]Note: [/b]this build is for the closed beta.  If that's not you, don't worry!  Stay tuned for roadmap updates later this month; we're (spoiler) targeting an early-access release by the end of the year!

[b]Build 2.01 Rev Notes[/b]

Major Updates:
[list]
[*] Revamped kingdom levelling: now, when you have enough food and lifestyle to upgrade your kingdom, YOU choose which units to unlock for this level.  Adds lots of variety to playstyle - will you rush mystics or military, merchants or scholars?  
[*] Revamped crossroads->village->town promotion.  Promoting a settlement now requires a certain # of retired units.
[*] Added unit aging and retirement for a lifestyle bonus.
[*] Added sailors and water movement.  Sailors are new units that can be recruited from any town or village (once you've unlocked them).
[*] Added 2 new terrain types: hills & plains.  Hills are great for ranches but can't support farms; plains support a limited palette of crops and animals.
[/list]

Smaller Updates:
[list]
[*] Added breakdown menus for income and resources
[*] Added breakdown menus for factions (from topbar) 
[*] Improved delegation flow
[*] Added "claim water" mechanic - if a player controls all terrain tiles adjacent to a water tile, the water tile will automatically be owned by the tile
[*] Added score sheet on game won/lost - show population, lifestyle score, bloodiness score, etc.
[*] Added a button to highlight/select the next idle unit.
[*] Added button to show other players' current lifestyle scores
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with renaming settlements and units in-game.
[*] Fixed various bugs related to in-game popups not layering, not clearing, and generally being messy.
[*] And many, many others...
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.32 Released! (Alpha)
notes.notes:
It's been a busy few months, but here we have the combined updates from version 1.20 and 1.30, now released and ready for testing!   Lots of design and clarity updates in this one; faction tracking is now front and center on the top bar, and faction leaders now give you a clearer idea of what they think of you, both in the council room and during events.   I've also tweaked the starting conditions to prevent a variety of difficult/impossible starts (goodbye, one-tile islands!).   Full details below; check it out and definitely let me know if you find any bugs!

(P.S. If you are not an alpha tester, do not despair!  Feast or Fracture is in active development and road-mapped for release at the end of this year.  Wishlist or follow us to stay in the loop!)


[i]New to this Version...[/i]

[b]Design & Clarity[/b]
[list]
[*] New faction tracking on the top bar
[*] Improved taxation GUI and cleaned up taxation effects on factions
[*] Highlight selected unit or village on the map
[*] Improved council display, including a desktop mirror to view your "self"
[*] Improved event display, adding icons and faction leader text to results
[*] Improved event structure; easy generation of new events
[*] Added new character dialogue for all 14 active characters, and added character comments in council 
[*] Cleaned up lifestyle tracking; lifestyle is now 1 number
[*] Turned off "fervor" tracking. Don't worry, we'll bring this back with the religion module!  (road-mapped for version 1.50)
[/list]
[b]Balance/Play[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed unit tree; level0 units are now farmers and warbands.
[*] Added grain silos as a level 0 building, built by farmers.  Re-enabled farmers building simple buildings.
[*] Added quarries (laborers produce stone, can only be built on mountains)
[*] Improved map script, prevent tiny island starts
[*] Removed random early bandits from easy difficulties
[*] Improved bandit/marauder script: opportunists.  Bandits will not attack tiles with a military unit guarding them.
[*] Updated starting bonuses for Ephraim, Tarissa, and Ying Tsu.
[/list]
[b]Fixed Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed crash related to generating faction leaders for specific factions
[*] fixed event popups overlapping bottom toggle bar
[*] fixed load saved games module failing to load all games
[*] fixed a bug that prevented various crops from growing on 'lonely mountain' tiles
[*] fixed a bug where the "Negotiate with a hamlet" window wasn't closing correctly
[*] fixed a bug that spawned bandits on turn 3 in every game.
[*] fixed a crash related to refugees generating with phantom "attackers"
[*] fixed several crashes related to failures of map generation.
[/list]

[b]Bonus points[/b] for reading this far - the roadmap for version 1.4x is to include rivers and a map editor!

notes.title: Version 0.90 Released! (Alpha Testing)
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

We've pushed a new patch out today - version 0.90, with lots of new content!  Highlights include:
[list]
[*] An all-new interactive battle window
[*] New effects, labels and descriptions for places of interest like Holy Sites, Sacred Pools and Tar Pits.  Any unit can now "discover" a place of interest.
[*] Added "Game Length" to the game setup menu, and reduced the size of all maps.  Allows faster games (especially for our testers!)
[/list]

And, of course, a long list of bug fixes.

As usual, this is an alpha build - so we're looking for your feedback, the good, the bad, and the ugly!  If you're already a tester, please use the online submission portal.  If you're not already a tester, make sure to Wishlist us to hear when the game is ready for release!

Best Regards,
Alex
